_meta.note: Unified catalog floor: one entry per service with blocking patterns AND declared cookies. Offline/day-1 fallback; the remote services.json wins per slug. Each cookie keeps its own category.

bootstrapcdn.label: BootstrapCDN
bootstrapcdn.description: Open-source library CDN for Bootstrap, Popper and Font Awesome.

cookies.name: MUID
cookies.purpose: Identifies unique web browsers visiting Microsoft sites. Used for advertising, site analytics, and other operational purposes.

cookies.name: _clck
cookies.purpose: Persists the Clarity User ID and preferences, unique to that site, on the browser. Ensures subsequent visits are attributed to the same user ID.

cookies.name: _clsk
cookies.purpose: Connects multiple page views by a user into a single Clarity session recording.

cookies.name: anonchk
cookies.purpose: Indicates whether MUID is transferred to ANID for use in authenticated services. Used for fraud prevention and analytics.

cookies.name: IDE
cookies.purpose: Used by Google DoubleClick to register and report website user actions after viewing or clicking advertiser ads. Enables measurement of ad effectiveness and personalized ads.

cookies.name: DSID
cookies.purpose: Used to identify a signed-in user on non-Google sites to respect ad personalization settings.

cookies.name: test_cookie
cookies.purpose: Used to check if the user's browser supports cookies. Set by DoubleClick.

cookies.name: _fbp
cookies.purpose: Facebook Pixel browser ID for advertising attribution and analytics.

cookies.name: _fbc
cookies.purpose: Stores the Facebook click ID (fbclid) to attribute conversions back to specific Facebook ads. Only set when user arrives via Facebook ad.

cookies.name: fr
cookies.purpose: Contains browser and user unique ID combination for targeted advertising.

cookies.name: _gcl_au
cookies.purpose: Used by Google AdSense for experimenting with advertisement efficiency across websites using their services. Helps track ad clicks and conversions.

cookies.name: __gads
cookies.purpose: Set by Google Ad Manager on publisher sites to track ad performance and user engagement.

cookies.name: _gcl_aw
cookies.purpose: Google Ads conversion linker cookie. Stores click information for conversion attribution.

cookies.name: _gcl_dc
cookies.purpose: Google Campaign Manager (DoubleClick) conversion linker cookie.

cookies.name: _gcl_gb
cookies.purpose: Google Ads and Analytics conversion linker for cross-domain tracking.

cookies.name: _ga
cookies.purpose: Used to distinguish unique users by assigning a randomly generated number as a client identifier. Included in each page request and used to calculate visitor, session and campaign data.

cookies.name: _gid
cookies.purpose: Used to store and update a unique value for each page visited. Groups user behavior across sessions within a 24-hour period.

cookies.name: _ga_<container-id>
cookies.purpose: Used to persist session state. Each GA4 property or data stream has its own cookie with unique container ID.

cookies.name: _gac_gb_<container-id>
cookies.purpose: Contains campaign-related information. Used by Google Ads to measure ad campaign performance.

cookies.name: _gat
cookies.purpose: Used to throttle request rate to limit data collection on high traffic sites.

cookies.name: FPID
cookies.purpose: First-party identifier used to distinguish users in GA4.

cookies.name: FPLC
cookies.purpose: Used for session management in GA4.

cookies.name: NID
cookies.purpose: Stores preferences and information for Google services shown on the map, including personalised ads.
cookies.description: Set by Google Maps to remember preferences and deliver personalised content.

cookies.name: 1P_JAR
cookies.purpose: Gathers website statistics and measures conversions for Google services.
cookies.description: Set by Google to collect site usage statistics.

cookies.name: _dc_gtm_UA-*
cookies.purpose: Used by Google Tag Manager to control loading of Google Analytics script.

cookies.name: gtm_auth
cookies.purpose: Google Tag Manager environment authentication token for preview mode.

cookies.name: _hjid
cookies.purpose: Hotjar cookie set when customer first lands on a page with the Hotjar script. Used to persist Hotjar User ID unique to that site.

cookies.name: _hjSessionUser_*
cookies.purpose: Set when user first lands on page. Used to persist Hotjar User ID unique to that site. Ensures behavior in subsequent visits attributed to same user ID.

cookies.name: _hjFirstSeen
cookies.purpose: Identifies a new user's first session on the website.

cookies.name: _hjIncludedInSessionSample
cookies.purpose: Set to determine if user is included in data sampling for session recordings.

imagekit.label: ImageKit
imagekit.description: Delivers the site's own media and assets.

jetpack-site-accelerator.label: Jetpack Site Accelerator
jetpack-site-accelerator.description: Delivers WordPress core, theme and plugin assets.

cookies.name: li_fat_id
cookies.purpose: LinkedIn First-Party Ad Tracking ID for conversion tracking. Captured from ad landing page URLs with click IDs.

cookies.name: lidc
cookies.purpose: Used for routing and load balancing to ensure page requests are routed to the same server in any browsing session.

cookies.name: bcookie
cookies.purpose: LinkedIn browser identification cookie for platform features.

cookies.name: bscookie
cookies.purpose: Secure browser identifier cookie used for authentication.

cookies.name: UserMatchHistory
cookies.purpose: LinkedIn Ads ID syncing for audience matching and retargeting.

cookies.name: lang
cookies.purpose: Remembers the user's selected language version of a website.

cookies.name: AnalyticsSyncHistory
cookies.purpose: Used to store information about the time a sync took place with the lms_analytics cookie.

cookies.name: li_gc
cookies.purpose: LinkedIn guest consent cookie for non-members visiting LinkedIn pages.

optimole.label: Optimole
optimole.description: Delivers the site's own images and assets.

cookies.name: _pin_unauth
cookies.purpose: Used by Pinterest for tracking unauthenticated users for advertising and analytics.

cookies.name: _pinterest_ct_ua
cookies.purpose: Pinterest conversion tracking for advertising campaigns.

cookies.name: _GRECAPTCHA
cookies.purpose: Provides spam and abuse protection by distinguishing humans from bots.
cookies.description: Set by Google reCAPTCHA for risk analysis; required for the anti-abuse check to work.

shortpixel.label: ShortPixel Adaptive Images
shortpixel.description: Delivers the site's own images and assets.

sigmize.label: Sigmize
sigmize.description: A/B testing, heatmaps, and session recording.

cookies.name: _scid
cookies.purpose: Snapchat client-side identifier for advertising attribution and measurement.

cookies.name: sc_click_id
cookies.purpose: Stores the affiliate click ID from a SureCart affiliate link so a later purchase is credited to that affiliate. Its lifetime follows the store's affiliate tracking length.

cookies.name: _ttp
cookies.purpose: Used by TikTok to track and improve the performance of advertising campaigns, measure conversions, and build audiences.

cookies.name: _tt_enable_cookie
cookies.purpose: Enables TikTok to set cookies for tracking and advertising.

cookies.name: personalization_id
cookies.purpose: Used by Twitter to track and personalize content and ads for users.

cookies.name: guest_id
cookies.purpose: Twitter identifier for logged-out users to track interactions and serve personalized content.

cookies.name: vuid
cookies.purpose: Collects data on visitor behaviour across websites that embed Vimeo videos.
cookies.description: Vimeo analytics cookie that tracks views of embedded videos.

cookies.name: player
cookies.purpose: Saves the user's video-player preferences (volume, quality, captions).
cookies.description: Set by Vimeo to remember embedded-player settings.

cookies.name: __cf_bm
cookies.purpose: Distinguishes humans from bots to protect the embedded content.
cookies.description: Cloudflare bot-management cookie served with Vimeo embeds.

cookies.name: VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE
cookies.purpose: Estimates the user's bandwidth and limits ad interruptions on embedded videos.
cookies.description: Set by YouTube to measure bandwidth and personalise the embedded player experience.

cookies.name: YSC
cookies.purpose: Registers a unique ID to keep statistics of the videos the user has seen.
cookies.description: Session cookie set by YouTube to track views of embedded videos.

cookies.name: VISITOR_PRIVACY_METADATA
cookies.purpose: Stores the visitor's cookie consent state for the current domain.
cookies.description: Set by YouTube to record the visitor's privacy/consent metadata.

cookies.name: PREF
cookies.purpose: Stores player preferences such as preferred playback settings.
cookies.description: Set by YouTube to remember embedded-player preferences.

cookies.name: CONSENT
cookies.purpose: Stores the visitor's consent state for Google services.
cookies.description: Set by Google to persist the visitor's consent choices.
